evals.prompt: I uploaded a research paper on climate change impacts. Can you summarize it for me? The file is research_paper.pdf
evals.expected_output: A structured Academic/Research summary with sections: What This Paper Is About, Key Findings, Methodology, Results & Evidence, Conclusions & Implications, Limitations, and Key Takeaway. Uses the academic template with emoji headings.

assertions.text: Summary uses the Academic template with emoji-prefixed section headings (🎯, 🔍, 🧪, 📊, 💡, ⚠️, 📌)
Summary identifies document type as Academic/Research paper
Summary includes a Key Findings section with at least 3 bullet points
Summary ends with an offer to go deeper or answer questions

evals.prompt: Hey, can you give me the TL;DR of this contract my boss sent me? It's called vendor_agreement.pdf and I just need to know the key obligations and if there's anything sketchy.
evals.expected_output: A Legal/Contract summary covering: Purpose, Parties Involved, Key Terms & Clauses, Important Obligations, Financial Terms, Termination, and Notable Red Flags. Includes a legal disclaimer. Uses plain language.

assertions.text: Summary flags any notable risks or red flags in a dedicated section
Summary includes a legal disclaimer advising to consult an attorney
Language is in plain English, avoiding unexplained legal jargon

evals.prompt: Summarize this 80-page annual report for me. I need to understand what the company's financial health looks like and what their strategy is going forward. File: annual_report_2024.pdf
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive Business/Report summary with Executive Summary, Key Points, Data & Evidence (financial highlights), Recommendations/Strategy, and Bottom Line. Given the 80-page length, the summary should be detailed (~600-900 words) and reference key financial figures.

assertions.text: Summary uses the Business/Report template with at least 4 sections
Summary includes financial data or metrics (even if placeholder/illustrative)
Summary addresses both financial health and forward strategy as requested
Given 80-page document, summary is detailed and comprehensive (not just 2-3 sentences)
